effective_advertised_grammar.description:
Extract only the latest user message, never earlier consent. Current phase: {{phase}}. Exact tagged-row grammar: k=KIND;c=0_OR_1;[optional key=value;]END. Rows separated by a single newline. No quotes, JSON, empty fields, extra separators or trailing newline. Required k and c. c=0 for unfinished answers or corrections, c=1 only complete. Optional p=exact product ID or spoken type/label; a=plain positive decimal amount; d=verbatim exact date phrase (today, tomorrow, this/next weekday, YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY, day month year); v=security answer (DOB verbatim date, phone exactly four digits); t=HH:MM. Values may contain only letters, numbers, spaces, underscore, period, slash, colon, hyphen. No escaping: if a value needs a delimiter, emit k=unknown;c=1;END. Unknown/duplicate keys forbidden. Kinds: agree callback change confirm deceased decline dispute hardship human paid plan proposal purpose question recipient refuse security stop third_party too_much unknown vague wrong_number. Recipient only explicit yes/thats me/speaking/own name; greeting is unknown. Security v must preserve numeric DOB as day/month/year. Proposal a/d only positive asserted payment terms, never negated or incidental dates. Partial amount/date retains its target. Agreement to an actual spoken offer is agree; clear unqualified yes after readback is confirm. Qualified yes with new terms is proposal; incomplete correction c=0. paid means current arrears already paid, historical closed/paid off is dispute; negated claims do not count. Hardship outranks plans/refusal but include any voluntary a/d. Human/plan/stop outrank incidental keywords. One row per distinct target; collective yes can use one unscoped agree/confirm only when it clearly covers all spoken offers/readback. Examples (literal valid outputs):
k=recipient;c=1;END
k=security;c=1;v=14 October 1980;END
k=security;c=1;v=1234;END
k=proposal;c=1;p=credit card;a=120;d=next Friday;END
k=agree;c=1;p=personal loan;END
k=confirm;c=1;END
k=proposal;c=0;p=car loan;a=50;END
k=callback;c=1;d=tomorrow;t=15:00;END
k=proposal;c=1;p=credit card;a=120;d=next Friday;END
k=refuse;c=1;p=personal loan;END
k=paid;c=1;p=car loan;END
effective_advertised_grammar.amount_output: Plain positive decimal a; decoder regex accepts digits with optional one/two decimal places, so output comma is invalid. Decoder itself does not enforce >0; downstream amount rules enforce floor.
effective_advertised_grammar.input_comma: Raw amount 1,250 can be represented as a=1250. Plain-decimal requirement permits/requires numeric normalization; amount is not declared verbatim. No inference or observed extractor call establishes forced unknown.
effective_advertised_grammar.security_date_output: DOB preserves day/month/year numeric meaning; named-month dates are accepted.
effective_advertised_grammar.qualified_yes: Complete qualified yes with new terms is proposal;c=1. Incomplete correction is c=0. Negated/incidental terms must not populate positive a/d.
effective_advertised_grammar.unknown: A value truly needing an unrepresentable delimiter can yield unknown; this is distinct from a normalized numeric amount. Genuine complete non-answer can also be unknown.
effective_advertised_grammar.date_phrase_limit: d is advertised as verbatim exact date phrase. The parser accepts dates with explicit year, today/tomorrow, and this/next/unqualified weekday. It does not implement 23rd of October or Monday the nineteenth verbatim. This is a static producer/parser coverage risk; no additional target execution was done after the 24-control cap.
effective_advertised_grammar.completion_wording_ambiguity: Early text says c=0 for unfinished answers or corrections, but later specific text says qualified yes with new terms is proposal and incomplete correction is c=0. Complete corrections were controlled as proposal;c=1; occurrence of extractor misflagging is unknown.

findings.verdict: Producer first-amount failure not established; stale amount/date behavior reproduced only after semantic fault injection.
findings.action: Use final unambiguous asserted amount 673.50 and positive Friday, as the correct control does. Consider ambiguity-specific clarification only when terms remain ambiguous; do not force clarification merely because a completed self-correction occurred.
findings.correction_to_review: In its exact scenario, floor was already offered after too_much. Injected 616 consumes an attempt rather than making a first floor offer; pre-floor control reproduces the generic first-floor branch.

findings.verdict: Proper complete date-only correction and retry pipeline pass locally; genuine unfinished date correction reproduces wrong-component question.
findings.action: Track the unresolved component on c=0; retain known amount, invalidate the superseded date/readback, and ask only for the unfinished date. Keep complete qualified yes with new date as proposal;c=1.
findings.correction_to_review: Misclassified confirm and incorrectly c=0 on complete speech are semantic injections, not established extractor output. Both fail closed for writes. Fail_first_n=1 succeeds in local synthetic receipts only.

findings.verdict: Comma-forces-unknown premise unsupported. Plain a=1250 is valid; the observed successful readback used an injected date expansion, so exact original-date extractor behavior is not established.
findings.action: Explicitly document amount normalization and distinguish a producer parse failure from an actual complete non-answer; preserve A30 non-answer accounting. Separately clarify or support date phrases missing a year instead of silently assuming a verbatim date round trip.
findings.correction_to_review: Forbidden comma is a restriction on OUTPUT, not raw speech. Decoder-invalid a=1,250 clarifies without consuming an attempt. Fake verification, foreign cid, and fake recorded status remain untrusted in local controls. Original raw date was 23rd of October; successful local row used 23 October 2026, an explicit semantic assumption. The strict decoder grammar forbids comma in a, but does not require an amount to preserve input punctuation.

findings.verdict: Conditional namespace risk, not hosted-runtime failure proven.
findings.evidence: Two independent-dictionary strict exec probes return safe_failure: run cannot resolve datetime imported into locals. Conditional linked-locals execution restores definition visibility without modifying source.
findings.action: If the actual sandbox uses independent globals/locals without definition visibility, dispatch helpers need compatible scoping. Verify actual sandbox semantics before claiming a platform defect; no hosted test was run.
